conditions.why: an N-step COUPLED weight trajectory, with the two sides actually moving. ITS OPERATING POINT, added pass 390 (R154) because '20 steps, coupled, 89.21 %' reads as if the update rule were swept and it was not: in this arm the LR is a strictly linear ramp reaching 11.4 % of peak, never the knee at 1000 or the decay at 50000; the clip coefficient is exactly 1.0 at all 20 steps and all 80 per-sample coefficients, 12.5703x below the threshold; participation_spread is [4] at every step, so the per-parameter divisor is a uniform scaling Adam cancels; n_disabled_last_sample is 0 at every step; and weight_decay is 0.0, which is upstream's own default. That is five factors single-valued or inert, and it is PROTOCOL's factorisation working rather than a hole -- the four state-free factors are driven with a controlled input EXACTLY because a real batch never hits their corners. Two of the five are covered outside this artifact and are named as such: the non-uniform participation divisor only by superseded arms, and the disabled-parameter path only by COVERAGE's 5oid datapoint.
